tools.name: marketplace_status
tools.description: Read public marketplace availability, sandbox scope, service category and joining links. This tool does not register agents or spend money.

tools.name: marketplace_joining_instructions
tools.description: Read how outside buyers and providers can join an available Aiven Marketplace instance. Includes native API and downloadable client. Does not enroll or transact.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "marketplace_joining_instructions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
